product_metadata.title: AWS - Digital Pocket Weight Scale 600g x 0.1g - (Silver)
features: MASTERED EXCELLENCE: As the TOP SELLING MANUFACTURER of digital pocket scales, AMERICAN WEIGH SCALES is known for its INNOVATIVE WEIGHS on precision. We are Amazon’s choice on many of our models. Don’t be confused when it comes to your weighing needs, buy with confidence knowing we have your back with our AMERICAN WEIGH SCALES 10 YEAR WARRANTY!

PRECISE MEASUREMENT: The AWS-600 has a capacity of 600g x 0.01 offering accuracy and precision with every weigh. Tried and true measuring while offering a modern and easy to use scale. Our scale offers all weighing units in a rainbow of color changing modes to be ever so easy on the eyes even in dim lighting. OVER 20 YEARS of experience in manufacturing the most reliable scales on the market.

WEIGHING ON-THE-GO: This scale is a MULTIFUNCTIONAL WEIGHING TOOL that can fit in the smallest of spaces. Weigh just about anything in grams, ounces, grains, and carats. Portable, lightweight and convenient for all your gems, gold, coins, and even coffee too!

PREMIUM ACCESSORIES: The AWS-600 includes BONUS ACCESSORIES you will love, a microfiber cloth, premium VIP book and manual to get you started on your weighing journey. You’ll appreciate the stylish design and durability of the AWS-600.
